question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT words
    FROM word_list
    WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
      AND words LIKE 'r%'
),
with_signature AS (
    SELECT words,
           STRING_AGG(SUBSTR(words, n, 1), '' ORDER BY SUBSTR(words, n, 1)) AS signature
    FROM filtered, UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, LENGTH(words))) AS t(n)
    GROUP BY words
),
signature_groups AS (
    SELECT signature, COUNT(DISTINCT words) AS total_anagrams
    FROM with_signature
    GROUP BY signature
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT words) >= 2
)
SELECT ws.words, (sg.total_anagrams - 1) AS anagram_count
FROM with_signature ws
JOIN signature_groups sg ON ws.signature = sg.signature
ORDER BY ws.words ASC
LIMIT 10
